title: AI chat page: every visit with no cached conversation creates an empty "New conversation" row (create on first send)
body:
repo:cloud#2 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbWTyRFQwYN1hZXbCHL


## What happens

A user who opens the full-page AI chat (`/_console/ai`) a few times gets a chat list of empty "New conversation" rows. Reported from a clean licensed EE install (consumer: objectstack-ai/cloud#4224 item 3), on walled and single.

## Where it comes from

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useChatConversation.ts` resolves a conversation as soon as the page mounts. When nothing is cached for `(user, scope)` in `localStorage`, it calls `createConversation(apiBase)` (`POST /api/v1/ai/conversations` with body `{}`) before the user has typed anything (line ~1020 at origin/main). The cache is empty in common cases:

- after every sign-in, because `purgeChatCaches()` clears all `objectstack:ai-chat-*` keys on a user change or logout;
- in a new browser or profile, or after site data is cleared;
- whenever the page is opened with `?new` (`forceNew`), and on `startNew()`, which mint a row even when the current conversation is still empty.

The resume path already avoids this for a cached empty conversation (it reuses it), so the leak is only on the create paths above.

## Expected

No conversation row exists until the first message is sent. Either create on first send (the pane holds a pending id until the first submit, which the page already supports for the empty-state first message), or, before creating, reuse the caller's newest conversation for the same scope when it has no messages (read through `GET /api/v1/ai/conversations?limit=…`).

## Why not on the server

Reusing an empty row inside `POST /api/v1/ai/conversations` is not safe: the console sends `{}` with no scope, so an ask visit and a build visit would be handed the same id, and the client caches it under both scopes. The scope is only known in the console.

## Done when

- Opening `/_console/ai` N times (including across sign-out/sign-in) with no message sent leaves no empty conversation row.
- `?new` and "New conversation" do not mint a second empty row while the current one is still empty.
- A test in `useChatConversation.test.tsx` pins both.

Consumer: objectstack-ai/cloud#4224 (item 3; the cloud PR closes the card's other two items with `Part of #4224`).

Dedupe terms: `useChatConversation createConversation empty`, `New conversation empty rows`, `create conversation on first send`.
